title: Bump opum-lore and opum-quest federated pins to v0.14.1 in one change and publish the marketplace
description: Opum constitution Article 3 clause 4 and clause 7: opum-marketplace pins opum-lore and opum-quest to the same version, moves both pins in ONE change, and the pair release is not finished until the marketplace publishes them at 0.14.1. opum-doc daily brief checks this every day. Filed 2026-10-19 on the orchestrator relay for the operator-released lore 0.14.1 plus quest 0.14.1 pair. DO NOT START until both @opum-ai/lore and @opum-ai/quest are published at npm latest 0.14.1 AND both v0.14.1 release tags exist; the orchestrator signals the go. Pins are v0.13.0 on dev and main at filing time.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Prerequisite, checked before any pin moves: npm dist-tags latest reads 0.14.1 for both @opum-ai/lore and @opum-ai/quest, and both v0.14.1 release tags exist in opum-ai/lore-cli and opum-ai/quest-cli. Each tag chain is re-resolved at bump time via the GitHub git-database API and git ls-remote, never taken from the release announcement or from tag-cut-time numbers.

ONE pull request into dev moves both entries together: .claude-plugin/marketplace.json declares source.ref = v0.14.1 for opum-lore and for opum-quest, and scripts/federated-pin-baselines.json records ref = v0.14.1 with the skills subtree SHA re-resolved at v0.14.1 for both entries, in the same commit.
At each pinned tag, .claude-plugin/plugin.json self-declares version 0.14.1, and the resolved skills/ subtree SHA equals the one recorded in scripts/federated-pin-baselines.json for that entry.

scripts/check-federated-content.mjs exits 0 against the bumped pins and the updated baselines, run locally and green in CI on the pull request head, and every required check on that pull request is green. A v0.13.0 positive control in the same invocation resolves the recorded v0.13.0 baseline.

Published state, read back after promotion: .claude-plugin/marketplace.json fetched from origin/main (the remote ref, not the working tree and not a remembered SHA) declares source.ref = v0.14.1 for both opum-lore and opum-quest.

implementationNotes: AMENDED 2026-10-20 from 0.14.0 to 0.14.1 in the title, description and all five ACs, on the orchestrator relay (Rev 285). Reason: lore v0.14.0 Release run failed its gate, so both v0.14.0 tags stay tagged-never-published; the pair was retargeted to 0.14.1 under DEC-204 (2) (orchestrator note on OPAG-1430, 2026-10-20 ~00:50Z). Amendment made through quest before any pin moves. The DEC-204 text itself was not read by this session.

STAGE 1 VERDICT for opum-ai/opum-marketplace#219 at 94f05edb429c11276548907900394b505de5a63c, recorded verbatim. Reviewer: leader-spawned unit opum-marketplace-review-219-94f05ed, model claude-opus-5-5 on all 40 assistant turns, read from its transcript 15158562-7740-4345-9dd0-35a0d3d66a4f.jsonl (sha256 a4892d7c0e41dc05aca7527bac9326e2703a7e6960c71f66e8cef52413e0124a). Verdict file sha256 d43fc924d1fc3ac109a1f381a193ae2065a6a251505e52812ef6cf1d475a07c6 (checked before copying). Text follows.
Verdict for opum-ai/opum-marketplace#219 (OMARK-93) at 94f05ed: APPROVE, both pins and both baselines move together to v0.14.1, every SHA matches the leader's measurements, and the CI gates in this PR would fail on a pin or baseline mismatch.

VERDICT: APPROVE

AC SCORES:
1. met — scripts/federated-pin-baselines.json:51,57 record the chain and say it was re-resolved through ls-remote and the git-database API, with npm latest at 0.14.1. Every value matches the leader's measurements: lore tag 1f084dd5, commit 85d583c8, root 65a5aaaa, skills 060393c9; quest tag ad34fcd6, commit 053d8595, skills 6df997f2. CI's lore-check job installs lore at the pin version (ci.yml:233-264), so lore 0.14.1 is installable. CI installs quest 0.13.0 (from CLAUDE.md), so npm quest 0.14.1 rests only on the leader's measurement. I cannot verify the "before any pin moves" order: the PR is one commit.
2. met — .claude-plugin/marketplace.json:49,77 both read v0.14.1. Baselines :48-49 and :54-55 have ref v0.14.1 and the re-resolved skills trees. Everything is in the single commit 94f05ed on base bce7b58.
3. met — the skills trees match the leader's independent values. CI proves both halves. ci.yml:153 runs check-federated-pins.mjs because marketplace.json changed, and it fails unless plugin.json version equals the ref minus "v" (check-federated-pins.mjs:74). ci.yml:190 runs the content checker because both files changed. It fails on a baseline ref that differs from the pin (check-federated-content.mjs:100) and on a tree SHA mismatch (:107), then exits 1 (:142-144). check · manifests is SUCCESS, so both are proven.
4. met in purpose — the exit-0 and green-required-checks clauses are met in CI. The literal "v0.13.0 positive control in the same invocation" cannot be met with the shipped checker. checkMarketplace resolves only the refs in marketplace.json (:118), and :100 rejects any baseline whose ref is not the pin, so no v0.13.0 control can run in that invocation without a code change. The purpose of the control is still served in that same invocation. Seven unchanged entries (diagram-skills, housekeeping-skills, opum-output-styles, plain-english-styles, proof-skills, test-skills, yaml-lsp) go through the same resolveSubtree path and must each match a baseline verified earlier. Those are live positive controls. The summary refuses a zero-read pass (:152-155), and scripts/test/check-federated-content.test.mjs (ci.yml:98) proves the reject cases. The writer's by-hand v0.13.0 resolution is a separate tool run, not the checker. It is also not recorded anywhere in the PR (see finding 1).
5. not yet due — after promotion, read origin/main's marketplace.json.

FINDINGS:
1. MINOR, .quest/tasks/OMARK-93.json:1 (implementationNotes). The only note is the 0.14.0→0.14.1 retarget. Nothing records how AC4's positive control was met: the by-hand v0.13.0 trees matching 437ae5a9 and e05b68c2, and the seven unchanged entries in the same CI run. Nothing records the local exit-0 run either. Add a note before checking AC4, so a ticked AC does not claim a literal clause that was not run. Follow-up: either add a control mode to the checker or reword this AC template. The AC asked for something the tool cannot do.
2. NIT, .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md:59,64. The 2-line change is the `link` line (adds "or a decision id to its decisions:") and the `schema` line (adds "; commit the result"). The file has no begin/end markers: all of it is generated (trailer at :107). So "between the managed markers" is the wrong description, but the change is generated. CI's `lore agents --check` at 0.14.1 (ci.yml:276-277) is green, which proves the bytes are current.
3. NIT (judgment, no defect). The 11 .lore/schemas files look like generator output. All 11 swap x-lore-generator.profileDigest the same way, sha256:63d799a9… → sha256:997dc4f9…, and only adr gains content. The adr +14 is that digest line plus a new optional top-level `decisions` property, `anyOf [array of string, null]` (adr.schema.json:76-88). That matches the SKILL.md `link` change. They are required, not scope creep: CI's lore check runs lore 0.14.1 (version taken from the pin) and fails on schema drift, and it is green.
4. NIT, CLAUDE.md managed Quest block. It still declares Quest CLI 0.13.0. After this PR, the Tracker integrity and lore-check jobs run quest 0.13.0 beside a quest pin of 0.14.1, a pair that was never released together. This is outside the ACs. Follow-up: run the routine `quest agents --update-instructions --target claude` at 0.14.1.
5. NIT, pre-existing, check-federated-content.mjs:104-111. A baseline whose `trees` is empty or missing passes and counts as verified, with nothing compared. It is not triggered here: both entries carry a skills tree. Possible follow-up: require at least one tree per in-scope baseline.

.agents/plugins/marketplace.json:35,61 reads v0.14.1 and agrees with the Claude manifest. The `generate-codex-marketplace.mjs --check` step inside check · manifests (ci.yml:81-82) enforces this, and it is green.

LIMITS: I had no shell or git, so I could not see the PR diff against bce7b58. "Only lore/quest moved" was checked against another worktree at 6d10d27, which I could not place on dev (no match in packed-refs or logs). I compared names, refs, trees and verifiedAt for all nine entries; all match except the two bumped entries. I compared description text only for opum-lore and opum-quest, not the other seven entries' descriptions or baseline notes. The 11 schema digests were compared the same way. I took the green CI results from the leader and did not see the step logs, including the "N of 9 resolved and matched" line. I could not re-resolve any tag, read plugin.json at the tags, or read npm. Quest's root tree a5f5593f (baselines:57) was cross-checked by no one. The writer's local exit-0 run and the by-hand v0.13.0 trees are unverified claims. The retarget rests on a relayed DEC-204 that the writer's note says it did not read. This does not block: the tags and npm latest are 0.14.1.

AC4 EVIDENCE (answers review finding 1). (1) By-hand v0.13.0 control, resolved by this session through the git-database API (tag -> commit -> root tree -> skills): lore-cli v0.13.0 skills/ 437ae5a97cce348f0e5bda24ccedb1e1afc29960 and quest-cli v0.13.0 skills/ e05b68c27490ea1037fc92700576e35a2ec37fb9, both equal to the baselines recorded before the bump. The leader resolved the same two trees independently and they agree. (2) The shipped checker has no control mode, so the literal in-invocation v0.13.0 control was not run; in that same invocation the seven unchanged entries (diagram-skills, housekeeping-skills, opum-output-styles, plain-english-styles, proof-skills, test-skills, yaml-lsp) resolved and matched their baselines as live controls. (3) Local run: node scripts/check-federated-content.mjs exit 0, 9 of 9 entries matched; with the old baseline file and the new pin it failed on purpose, naming both entries. CI check · manifests green on the PR head and on origin/dev a37efbf. AC4 is checked as met in purpose, not in the literal clause. Tooling half and NIT 5 are filed as OMARK-96, not started.

LCLI-469 CROSS-CHECK, 2026-10-20: lore-cli's handshake (tag v0.14.1, tag object 1f084dd5e97a7c57b150f7735d7d6b6ce702cbdc, peeled commit 85d583c8c4338df6da65b57f9f4230c99ecea10e, root tree 65a5aaaa9d7c23cc2bbffc4e3b435f7426eb7546, skills/ 060393c9020e4401d1068bee0cd4e4c96ac4e0e8) matched this session's own resolution on all five values.

finalSummary: OMARK-93 done. Paired bump of opum-lore and opum-quest to v0.14.1 (retargeted from 0.14.0 under DEC-204 (2)). Landed through opum-ai/opum-marketplace#219 (squash a37efbf497ecf742fb17fd660ab2c37ce151c98b), required checks green at that SHA, promoted by fast-forward; origin/main marketplace.json read back at ref v0.14.1 for both. lore skills/ 060393c9, quest skills/ 6df997f2, re-resolved here and matching the LCLI-469 handshake. Regenerated .lore/schemas and the lore skill bridge for 0.14.1. Stage 1 APPROVE (claude-opus-5-5); AC4 met in purpose, follow-up OMARK-96.
